title: 3-Day Cultural & Heritage Journey to Indore

days.title: Day 1: Highlights of Indore & Sarafa Night Food Market
days.summary: A balanced day combining morning exploration at Sarafa Night Food Market, authentic lunch with Indori Poha-Jalebi, and vibrant evening market life.

stay.name: Lemon Tree Hotel or WOW Hotel
stay.description: Comfortable Moderate accommodation well-situated for local transit in Indore.
stay.booking_advice: Recommended booking 1-3 weeks in advance for best seasonal rates in India.

activities.title: Exploration of Sarafa Night Food Market
activities.description: Start the morning early to beat the crowds at Sarafa Night Food Market. Soak in the history and architecture with an atmospheric morning walk.

activities.title: Authentic Culinary Feast & Rajwada Palace
activities.description: Enjoy lunch featuring Indori Poha-Jalebi. Continue with an unhurried visit to Rajwada Palace during the quieter afternoon hours.
activities.transit_info: Walking distance or short 2 km e-rickshaw ride

activities.title: Sunset Stroll, Market Exploration & Dinner
activities.description: Experience the vibrant evening colors of Indore. Walk through bustling local lanes, taste Sev Tamatar, and shop for local handicrafts.
activities.transit_info: Clean city buses (iBus BRTS), e-rickshaws, and auto rickshaws with metered/fixed fares.
